messages:
maya: opened a small PR to soften SLA wording in dedicated docs so we don't imply per-tenant latency guarantees. preview: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2345
kevin: can you paste the new sentence here? i'll do a quick skim
maya: new phrasing: \"Dedicated Capacity offers latency objectives per-queue under typical load; individual request latency may vary based on model, sequence length, and tenant isolation.\" (section 4.2) trying to avoid the word 'guarantee'
sam: does this change the example SLO table? we used p50/p95 mapping previously
maya: updated the p50/p95 rows and added a footnote about isolation and preemption behavior. also swapped the SLA matrix CSV link to the canonical one
lin: heads-up — examples/python/dedicated_provision.py still uses `sla='guaranteed'`. i'll push a tiny snippet fix to use `sla_policy='objective'` or remove the deprecated field
kevin: can someone scan docs for the term 'eviction' vs 'preemption'? we settled on 'preemption' last month and there are a few stray usages
alex: deploy-bot: docs preview built: https://deploy-preview-2345--docs.redwood.com
maya: thanks @deploy-bot. @lin, can you paste your snippet here so i can update the PR with the corrected code block
lin: snippet: ```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.create_capacity(name=\"team-a\", tier=\"reserved\", sla_policy=\"objective\", isolation_labels={\"tenant\": \"team-a\"})
``` changed `sla_policy` string and added a short note about fallback routing
sam: tiny nit on the footnote wording: "may be subject to preemption" -> please change to "may be subject to capacity preemption" for clarity
maya: updated the footnote and added a one-line migration hint in migrations/README: CLI example: `rwctl capacity migrate --from legacy-reserved --to reserved-pool-1 --grace-period 300`
kevin: can we add a redirect from /docs/dedicated/sla -> /docs/dedicated/availability? there are external links that need to keep working
maya: added redirect entry in _redirects.md and pinged SEO. left a TODO for i18n: flagged the new SLA sentence for localization review
lin: PR is ready for review; pinging @kevin @sam for sign-off. i'll merge after approvals and a clean docs build
kevin: quick check — snippet extraction linter? we have a test that runs sample-snippet parsing
alex: run locally: `make docs-lint && python -m pytest docs/snippets/test_snippets.py::test_dedicated_snippets` — passed for me
sam: :+1: approving once linter in CI is green
maya: merging in ~15m unless anyone objects
kevin: one last ask — can docs add a short note in the provisioner section about labeling best-practices (tenant tags, env) so onboarding customers don't accidentally create ultra-broad isolation labels
maya: added a small note and an example YAML snippet explaining `isolation_labels: {team: foo, env: prod}`
lin: thanks. i'll follow up to remove the old example that used `eviction_policy` string
kevin: ack. thanks all
_meta: created_by: maya; context: docs PR coordination for dedicated capacity SLA wording, snippet fixes, redirect and i18n flagging
